map.批量大小迭代次数是做什么的？: What does Batch Size and Iterations do?
map.如何使用批量大小迭代次数？: How do I use Batch Size and Iterations?
map.批量大小迭代次数适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Batch Size and Iterations best for?
map.每轮步数 = ⌈样本数 / 批量⌉；总步数 = 每轮步数 × 轮数；最后一批大小: Steps per epoch = ⌈samples / batch⌉; total steps = steps per epoch × epochs; last batch size = samples mod batch (if 0 use batch)
map.参数更新次数由\"样本数/批量\"决定而非轮数，直接决定训练时长与学习率调度横坐: The number of parameter updates is determined by "samples / batch" rather than epochs, which directly governs training time and the x-axis of the learning-rate schedule. When the last batch is incomplete you must decide whether to drop it (drop_last): dropping keeps BatchNorm statistics stable, keeping uses a bit more data.
map.最后一批可能不满。: The last batch may be incomplete.
map.每轮迭代步数 steps=⌈N/batch_size⌉，N 为训练样本总数。: Iteration steps per epoch steps=⌈N/batch_size⌉, where N is the total number of training samples.
map.总优化步数=epochs×steps；batch 越大单轮步数越少但显存与通信开: Total optimization steps = epochs × steps; a larger batch reduces steps per epoch but raises memory and communication cost.
map.N=10000, batch=32 → steps=⌈10000/32⌉=313: N=10000, batch=32 → steps=⌈10000/32⌉=313 steps/epoch; training 10 epochs totals about 3130 steps. With 4-GPU data parallelism at batch=32 each, the effective batch=128 and steps drop to 79/epoch.
map.batch size 是不是越大越好？: Is a larger batch size always better?
map.不是。大 batch 收敛快但泛化常变差，需配合更大学习率与更强正则；小 bat: No. A large batch converges faster but generalization often degrades, requiring a larger learning rate and stronger regularization; a small batch has noisier gradients yet often generalizes better, so you trade off memory against generalization.
map.最后一个不完整的 batch 怎么处理？: How to handle the last incomplete batch?
map.默认保留尾批(大小不足 batch)；也可 drop_last 丢弃以避免形状不: By default keep the tail batch (smaller than batch); you can also set drop_last to discard it to avoid shape mismatch, and steps use the ceiling which includes that tail batch.
